subject.title: [Feature]: Web Control UI browser panel with annotate-to-prompt and element inspect

question: Should maintainers sponsor this as a staged first-party Control UI browser workflow now?
rationale: Current main already supplies the required technical seams, so source inspection cannot decide the remaining product-priority and first-slice scope choice.

options.title: Approve staged panel
options.body: Start with navigation, tabs, screenshot refresh, and composer handoff, then add annotation and constrained inspection in follow-up work.

options.title: Approve full scope
options.body: Implement navigation, annotation, inspection, and interaction forwarding as one coordinated feature.

options.title: Defer feature
options.body: Keep the native macOS browser and manual web screenshot workflow until higher-priority Control UI work is complete.

recommendation.title: Approve staged panel
recommendation.body: Start with navigation, tabs, screenshot refresh, and composer handoff, then add annotation and constrained inspection in follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the native browser, browser RPC, terminal panel, descriptor, and composer surfaces.
